# ai studio

> ai studio is an international, multi-disciplinary architecture, design and urbanism practice with offices in London and Moscow. The studio designs contemporary architecture grounded in context — across master planning, public and private buildings, hospitality, mixed-use, residential, office and interior projects. ai studio was formed in 2018 following the split of Architects of Invention; the practice has been operating under its principal since 2005.

## Studio

- **Trading name:** ai studio (also styled "AI Studio")
- **Legal entity:** ai international ltd
- **Founder & Principal:** Anton Khmelnitskiy — MArch, Moscow Architectural Institute (1997); formerly Partner at Foster + Partners (2005–2018)
- **Disciplines:** architecture · design · urbanism
- **Project typologies:** residential, office, public, hospitality, mixed-use, masterplan, interior
- **Press categories:** media, interviews, awards
- **Working languages:** English, Русский (Russian), العربية (Arabic), 中文 (Chinese), Español (Spanish)

## Offices

- **London (HQ):** 79–89 Lots Road, London SW10 0RN, United Kingdom
- **Moscow:** 6 Novaya Ploshad', 109012 Moscow, Russia
